findings.quoted_text: Company will and hereby does, without further consideration, irrevocably assign to Reed's any and all worldwide right, title or interest that Company may now or hereafter possess in or to the Deliverables in perpetuity (or the maximum period permitted by Applicable Laws and Regulations) and Reed's accepts such assignment.

Company acknowledges and agrees that all Intellectual Property created by Company, its affiliates, representatives, or agents in connection with or resulting from any work or services related to the Products, including the Deliverables ("Work Product"), but excluding the Neutral Alcohol Beverage Base and excluding the Company's general know-how and independently developed production processes not specifically related to the Products, have been specially ordered and commissioned by Reed's, are works-made-for-hire from the moment of creation and that all such Work Product is and will be the sole and exclusive property of Reed's.

Company will and hereby does, without further consideration, irrevocably assign to [PARTY_D] any and all worldwide right, title or interest that Company may now or hereafter possess in or to the Deliverables in perpetuity (or the maximum period permitted by Applicable Laws and Regulations) and [PARTY_D] accepts such assignment.
findings.explanation: Intellectual property ownership of your work transfers immediately upon creation or assignment without being explicitly tied to receipt of full payment, creating a risk that you may not get paid for your work.
findings.suggested_change: Ownership of the Deliverables shall remain with the Contractor until the Contractor has been paid in full for the applicable work, upon which ownership shall transfer to the Client.

findings.explanation: Ownership of your work product transfers to the client upon creation rather than upon full payment, which is a risk if you are not paid.
findings.suggested_change: Ownership of the Work Product shall transfer to the Client upon receipt of full payment for the applicable services.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, I hope you are having a good week. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before we move forward and sign: - Regarding the clause stating that 'Company will and hereby does, without further consideration, irrevocably assign to [PARTY_D] any and all worldwide right, title or interest...', this links the transfer of intellectual property immediately without being tied to payment; I propose we change this so that ownership of the Deliverables remains with the Contractor until full payment is received. - Regarding the clause stating that '...all Intellectual Property created by Company... have been specially ordered and commissioned by [PARTY_D], are works-made-for-hire from the moment of creation...', this transfers ownership upon creation rather than upon full payment; I propose we modify the relevant clause so that ownership of the Work Product transfers upon receipt of full payment for the applicable services. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation on this. Best regards,
